summary.critical_finding: Chapters 0 and 9 are framing/synthesis, not standalone global theorems.

chapters.title: 再利用問題
chapters.forbidden_inference: 一度うまくいった表現 ⇒ 以後どの責任にも再利用できる表現
chapters.claim_ceiling: Chapter 0 poses the reuse problem. It does not claim that every reused representation fails or that one theorem subsumes all later source programmes.
remaining_recovery: Use Chapters 1–8 as the actual family of counterexamples; do not make Chapter 0 carry a standalone global theorem.

chapters.title: 観測が原理的に届かない範囲
chapters.forbidden_inference: 観測を豊かにした ⇒ 潜在機構に近づいた
chapters.claim_ceiling: This is an identification result under a declared multiplicative/channel model and calibration assumptions, not evidence that richer biological measurements generally move closer to the true mechanism in nature.

chapters.title: 先行することは、警告することではない
chapters.forbidden_inference: 損失に先行した ⇒ 損失を予告する
chapters.claim_ceiling: The result falsifies predictive-warning validity for the six frozen thresholds in the two tested finite-model ensembles. It does not show that genetic diversity contains no predictive information generally.

chapters.title: 境界の内側で、次に何を測るか
chapters.forbidden_inference: 測れるものは測る価値がある ⇒ 測る順序に良し悪しはない
chapters.claim_ceiling: This validates information-guided ordering on the declared controlled synthetic benchmark. It is not universal optimality over all ecological observation-design methods or evidence of a natural-system mechanism.

chapters.title: 一つの系に、状態は一つではない
chapters.forbidden_inference: 生態遺伝的に要約した ⇒ 五つの側面を代表した
chapters.claim_ceiling: The chapter supports target-dependent state separation in the declared finite closure. It does not claim that all five state variables are pairwise distinct in every configuration or that the same five-state taxonomy is sufficient in nature.

chapters.title: 未来を開くと、記憶が要る
chapters.forbidden_inference: 物理的境界が狭い ⇒ 必要な因果記憶も小さい
chapters.claim_ceiling: The narrow-boundary result is a finite synthetic witness. It is not evidence that a real island, corridor, or ecological network with a narrow physical boundary actually has large causal-interface memory.

chapters.title: 能力は知識を追い越す
chapters.forbidden_inference: 介入の規模が小さい ⇒ 表現と監視の負担も小さい
chapters.claim_ceiling: This is a finite deterministic existence theorem about declared capabilities and representations. It does not imply that every small intervention causes a large burden or quantify empirical monitoring cost in a real conservation programme.

chapters.title: 法則は構造置換を越えない
chapters.forbidden_inference: ある構造で成り立った法則 ⇒ 置換後の構造でも成り立つ法則
chapters.claim_ceiling: The results are finite and relative to declared source-target relations and carried label semantics. They do not infer real replacement histories or a unique natural history variable from ecological data.

chapters.title: 反復は、多様性の代わりにならない
chapters.forbidden_inference: 同じ手法を繰り返した ⇒ 証拠が強くなった
chapters.claim_ceiling: The conclusion is conditional on the declared failure-domain and availability/reliability contract. It does not say that repetition is never useful, only that raw replicate count cannot substitute for independent failure opportunities in general.

chapters.title: 総合 — 妥当性に特権的な方向はない
chapters.forbidden_inference: より詳細にする／より多く測る／より長く記憶する／より多く介入する ⇒ より妥当になる
chapters.claim_ceiling: The synthesis does not yet prove one global theorem that scientific adequacy is non-monotone in every possible notion of richness. The exact theorem is TU-1 on revisability; the broader no-privileged-direction claim is a disciplined synthesis across distinct source-owned counterexamples.
remaining_recovery: Keep the phrase 'no privileged direction' as a synthesis claim unless a future typed monotonicity/non-monotonicity theorem is proved across a common carrier and common adequacy order.
